alt: Three cutaway blocks of skin and the vessel beneath it, showing haemostasis in sequence. Left: intact vessel with red cells and platelets flowing freely. Middle: the wall is breached, blood escapes upward through the wound, and platelets are massing at the break. Right: the escaped blood has consolidated into a dark, sealed clot with platelets packed at the vessel breach. No clotting factors or cascade steps are labelled. Servier Medical Art.
